item.title: Review: Resident Evil Requiem (Switch 2) - Action And Horror Combine In A Series Highlight
item.description: Blood, blood, gallons of the stuff.There’s a moment during Resident Evil Requiem — actually, no, several moments — in which I laid the controller on my lap and just stared at the screen in awe. Over the last decade, the series has reclaimed its throne as the king of the survival horror genre, but Requiem pushes the quality bar higher than ever, presenting an experience that is equal parts fresh and nostalgic. item.title: Balatro's Back To Steal All Your Spare Time In New Switch 2 Version
item.description: Card life.Just when we thought we had managed to shake Jimbo and his super-addictive poker roguelike, LocalThunk has gone and released Balatro in an all-new Switch 2 edition. Oh boy, here we go again...The new version is now live on the Switch eShop for £12.79 / $14.99 (with a sweet NA sale bringing it down to $11.99), or as a free upgrade for anyone who already owns the Switch 1 base game — come on, it's difficult to argue with that.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Round Up: The Reviews Are In For Resident Evil Requiem
item.description: Another Re9uiem out of RequiTEN?Capcom is truly treating us Switch 2 owners this week, as it releases not only Resident Evil Biohazard and Village on the new hardware, but also the brand new Requiem. Yep, that's on the same day as other platforms!All of these launch on 27th February (a Pokémon Day surprise, if we've ever seen one), and today, the Requiem reviews have started rolling in to clue us up on Leon and Grace's latest.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Marvel Maximum Collection Revives Six Classic Superhero Titles On Switch
item.description: Limited Run teams up with Marvel and Konami.The physical distributor Limited Run Games is teaming up with Marvel and Konami to revive multiple retro games in the Marvel Maximum Collection.This superhero-sized collection, "coming soon" to Switch and other platforms, will feature six "classic titles" spanning across the Arcade, 8-bit and 16-bit consoles.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP - Switch 2 Edition And Upgrade Delayed Again
item.description: Update: You'll have to wait a few extra months.:In some other game delay news this week, Dragami Games has announced Lollipop Chainsaw RePOP - Switch 2 Edition (and its upgrade pack) will no longer arrive on 26th March 2026.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Stardew Valley Is Celebrating 10 Years With A Special Anniversary Broadcast
item.description: New marriage candidates, pre-release footage and more.The indie success story Stardew Valley is today celebrating its 10th anniversary. item.title: Rumour: Sony Apparently Has Gran Turismo Running On Switch 2, Just Don't Expect To See It
item.description: But why?PlayStation's Gran Turismo 7 has apparently been linked to the Switch 2 in a wild new rumour, but it doesn't necessarily mean what you might be thinking.This information comes from video game journalist Jeff Grubb, who recently responded to a fan on his show, asking a question about "the real driving simulator" and the possibility of it racing on to another platform.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
